item.title: Pentagon cracks down on religious waivers for beards
item.description: All currently approved religious accommodations for facial hair must be reevaluated under the new guidelines within 90 days.

item.title: Marines can now use optical sights with pistols for qualifying
item.description: This is the first time that Marines have been allowed to use an optical sight for pistol qualifications, a Corps spokesman said.

item.title: Air Force training instructor faces court-martial for sleeping with trainees
item.description: The charges against the military training instructor come more than a decade after a similar scandal rocked the Air Force.

item.title: US orders more warships, thousands of Marines to the Middle East
item.description: The Boxer Amphibious Ready Group, carrying the 11th Marine Expeditionary Unit, is the second ready force ordered to join the war in Iran.

item.title: Pentagon wants to increase naval, special operations capabilities on Greenland
item.description: U.S. Northern Command is seeking an agreement with Denmark to expand its operations on the island to three new areas.

item.title: French sailor goes running, reveals flagship’s location via fitness app
item.description: The French aircraft carrier the Charles de Gaulle is on its way to the Middle East. One sailor’s run pinpointed its position.

item.title: Army receives a new Black Hawk helicopter, pilot optional
item.description: The new H-60Mx now goes to testing as the Army works to expand its autonomous and remote-controlled arsenal.

item.title: National Guard mobilized for search and rescue operations amid Hawaii floods
item.description: Troops have helped rescue more than 200 people as large parts of Oahu remain drenched from flash floods in recent days.

item.title: Senator references Iwo Jima while pushing for US to take Kharg Island
item.description: Sen. Lindsey Graham recently referenced the bloody World War II battle while arguing for U.S. troops to seize the island from Iran.

item.title: Navy destroyer with grizzly bear battle flag pays tribute to heroic Marine
item.description: The ship’s namesake, retired Marine Col. Harvey C. Barnum Jr, was awarded the Medal of Honor for his heroism in Vietnam
